howto.what: 当你在 Flutter 项目中配置 Firebase 时，Claude 会指导你安装所需工具、运行 flutterfire configure、在 main.dart 中初始化 Firebase，并支持多 flavor 配置。它会提供命令行和代码示例，并强调关键步骤如不要手动修改 firebase_options.dart。
howto.when: 当你需要为 Flutter 项目添加或配置 Firebase 时触发，例如首次添加、运行 flutterfire configure、初始化 Firebase、或设置多环境 flavor 时。

say.note: Claude 会引导你完成安装和初始化。

say.text: 我想为我的 Flutter 应用添加多 flavor Firebase 配置。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through installing required tools, running flutterfire configure, initializing Firebase in main.dart, and configuring multiple flavors. It provides command-line and code examples, and highlights key steps such as not manually editing firebase_options.dart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add or configure Firebase for a Flutter project, such as first-time setup, running flutterfire configure, initializing Firebase, or setting up multiple flavor environments.

say_en.text: Help me configure Firebase for a Flutter project.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through installation and initialization.

say_en.text: I want to set up multiple flavor Firebase configurations.
say_en.note: Claude explains creating separate Firebase projects per environment.

say_en.text: What should I note when initializing Firebase?
say_en.note: Claude emphasizes calling ensureInitialized() and other steps.
